title: Jensen Huang : AI Is Computing About 8 million Pixels #jensenhuang  #ai #podcastclips
description:
NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang breaks down how artificial intelligence is fundamentally changing the way we render 4K graphics in real-time. Instead of putting heavy hardware stress on computing all 8 million pixels on a display, NVIDIA’s DLSS and AI prediction technology ray traces just a small sample of around 500,000 pixels. From those exact data points, the neural network accurately predicts and generates the remaining millions of pixels—delivering flawless, high-performance visual fidelity without sacrificing speed or image quality.
​Full conversation snippet from the Huge Conversations podcast with Cleo Abram!
​#NVIDIA #JensenHuang #Tech #AI #Gaming #Graphics #RayTracing #DLSS #HugeConversations
